name: NATO Archives Online
description: Official portal for declassified NATO documents, including North Atlantic Council and ministerial records, with full text search and reference services for restricted files.

name: Nationaal Archief
description: National archives of the Netherlands, holding records of the Dutch state since the Middle Ages, with an online catalogue and digitized government, family, and colonial records.

name: Swiss Federal Archives
description: Federal archives of Switzerland, preserving records of the Swiss confederation and cantonal cooperation, with online access to digitized files and public use requests.

name: National Archives of Ireland
description: Official archive of the Irish state, holding census returns, wills, and government papers, with online genealogy collections and reading room services in Dublin.

name: Arsip Nasional Republik Indonesia (ANRI)
description: National archives of Indonesia, managing government records and colonial era archives, with digitized collections, archival regulations, and research guidance.

name: Darwin Correspondence Project
description: Digital archive of letters to and from Charles Darwin, with complete transcriptions, editorial annotations, and biographical and topical essays for each calendar year.

name: Wellcome Collection
description: Free museum and library in London collecting material on health and human experience, with digitized archives, manuscripts, and an open access collections API.

name: Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS)
description: Official documentary record of United States foreign policy published by the Office of the Historian, presenting annotated volumes of declassified diplomatic documents.
publisher: US Department of State, Office of the Historian

name: National Library of China
description: National library of China in Beijing, the national bibliographic center, with digitized rare books, microfilm collections, a public catalogue, and academic digital resources.

name: National Library of Medicine
description: Biomedical national library of the United States, part of the NIH, publishing PubMed, MEDLINE, clinical tables, digitized books, and many documented health data APIs.

name: Royal Library of Belgium (KBR)
description: National and research library of Belgium in Brussels, holding Belgian heritage collections, manuscripts, prints, and patents, with the Belgica digital library.

name: Royal Danish Library
description: National library of Denmark and Copenhagen University Library, uniting national collections, digitized books and media, maps, and research services.

name: Austrian National Library
description: National library of Austria in Vienna, holding Habsburg era collections, papyri, maps, music, and portraits, with large scale digitized collections online.

name: National Library of Poland
description: National library of Poland in Warsaw, serving as the national bibliographic agency and providing the Polona digital library of Polish cultural heritage materials.

name: National Szechenyi Library
description: Hungary's national library in Budapest, collecting Hungarian publications and foreign scientific literature, with digitized materials and national bibliographic services.

name: Mother Jones
description: Investigative nonprofit newsroom covering politics, environment, and inequality, published by the Foundation for National Progress with a reader funded model.

name: The Intercept
description: Adversarial newsroom publishing national security, surveillance, technology, and corruption investigations, known for reporting on the Snowden archives.

name: Committee to Protect Journalists
description: Independent organization defending press freedom worldwide, publishing its attacks on the press database, journalist safety guidance, and an annual prison census.

name: Reporters Without Borders
description: International nonprofit defending press freedom, publishing the annual World Press Freedom Index, country reports, investigations, and assistance for journalists.

name: Pulitzer Center
description: Nonprofit supporting enterprising journalism on global issues through reporting grants, education programs, and partnerships with newsrooms and universities.

name: Nieman Journalism Lab
description: Publication of the Nieman Foundation at Harvard tracking the future of news, covering digital journalism innovation, research, and evolving business models.
publisher: Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard

name: International Press Institute
description: Global network of editors, media executives, and journalists defending press freedom, monitoring threats to journalism and running safety and legal support programs.

name: e-Luxemburgensia
description: Digital library of the National Library of Luxembourg with digitized Luxembourg newspapers, periodicals, and books, browsable by title and searchable by date.

name: Finnish Historic Newspapers and Journals
description: National Library of Finland service with digitized Finnish newspapers and journals from 1771 onward, searchable in full text in Finnish, Swedish, and other languages.

name: British Pathe
description: Newsreel archive spanning 1896 to 1976 with free online viewing of tens of thousands of clips covering world events, plus licensing options for reuse of footage.

name: BBC Genome Project
description: Searchable database of Radio Times listings from 1923 to 2009, cataloguing BBC television and radio schedules, programme credits, and staff names for broadcast research.

name: Canadiana
description: Digital heritage collections of the Canadian Research Knowledge Network, combining the Early Canadiana Online library with the Heritage microfilm digitization project.
access_requirements: Some Heritage collections are limited to subscribing institutions.

name: NewspaperArchive
description: Subscription genealogy service with digitized historical newspapers from small towns across the United States and other countries, searchable in full text.
access_requirements: Paid subscription required for full access.

name: Hemeroteca Digital Brasileira
description: Digitized Brazilian newspapers and periodicals from the National Library of Brazil, offering free full text search of issues from the nineteenth century onward.

name: Teyit
description: Turkish fact checking organization investigating viral claims about politics, health, and social media, publishing transparent verdicts with cited sources.

name: VERA Files
description: Philippine nonprofit news organization producing fact checks of official statements and viral claims, an IFCN signatory that runs election monitoring projects.

name: Demagog CZ
description: Czech fact checking team verifying political statements and debate claims, publishing verdicts with a public methodology and regular roundup articles.

name: dpa Fact Checking
description: Fact checking desk of the German news agency Deutsche Presse-Agentur, verifying viral claims and misinformation for newsrooms, publishing in English and German.

name: Facta
description: Italian fact checking outlet investigating viral claims and political statements, working with newsrooms across Italy and publishing open verification guides.

name: MyGoPen
description: Taiwanese fact checking service answering reader submitted questions about rumors, health claims, and viral messages, with a LINE bot for quick lookups.

name: Dogruluk Payi
description: Turkish fact checking platform that scores promises and statements by politicians against public records, budget data, and official statistics.

name: DANS
description: Netherlands institute for permanent archiving of research data, running Data Station platforms for depositing, finding, and reusing social science and other datasets.

name: KoboToolbox
description: Free and open data collection platform built for humanitarian and research settings, supporting offline forms, multilingual surveys, and team collaboration.

name: ODK
description: Open source suite of tools for mobile data collection, including ODK Collect for Android and the ODK Central server with a documented REST API.

name: J-PAL
description: Global research center at MIT running randomized evaluations of development programs, with policy outreach and open resources on impact evaluation methods.
publisher: Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab (MIT)

name: Innovations for Poverty Action
description: Nonprofit research organization designing and evaluating development programs through randomized trials, with country offices and open policy publications.

name: SciStarter
description: Directory of citizen science projects connecting volunteers with research projects across science domains, with participation tracking and project profiles.

name: Curate Science
description: Project organizing information about replications, reanalyses, and corrections of published findings so evidence from individual studies is easier to evaluate.

name: ASReview
description: Open source screening tool from Utrecht University that uses active learning to prioritize records during title and abstract screening for systematic reviews.

name: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE)
description: United Kingdom body producing evidence based guidance on health and social care, with published methods manuals, evidence reviews, and technology appraisals.
publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence

name: CASP (Critical Appraisal Skills Programme)
description: Charity offering validated critical appraisal checklists and training for reading research evidence, widely used in journal clubs and evidence synthesis teaching.

name: INAHTA
description: International network of health technology assessment agencies sharing reports, methods, and best practice across member organizations worldwide.
publisher: International Network of Agencies for Health Technology Assessment

name: SIGN
description: Scottish programme publishing evidence based clinical guidelines with graded recommendations, plus methodology handbooks and critical appraisal resources.

name: IQWiG
description: German institute assessing the benefit and harm of health interventions for the Federal Joint Committee, publishing evidence reports and plain language health information.
publisher: Institute for Quality and Efficiency in Health Care

name: metafor
description: R package for meta-analysis providing fixed and random effects models, moderators, forest and funnel plots, and diagnostic tools for publication bias.

name: Stan
description: Open source probabilistic programming platform for Bayesian modeling, with full Bayesian inference, variational approximation, and interfaces for R, Python, and more.

name: FORCE11
description: International community of scholars, funders, and publishers advancing scholarly communication, home of the FAIR data principles and guidance on data citation.

name: CodeRefinery
description: Nordic training program teaching research software engineering practices, version control, reproducible pipelines, and collaborative development through open workshops.

name: Better Scientific Software
description: Curated knowledge base of practices, tools, and resources for better scientific software, maintained for United States Department of Energy computing communities.

name: US Research Software Engineers Association
description: Professional community building recognition and careers for research software engineers in the United States, with community resources and institutional guidance.

name: ReproducibiliTEA
description: Journal club initiative and podcast where research groups discuss open science and reproducibility papers, with materials for starting local chapters.

name: JASP
description: Free open source statistical software from the University of Amsterdam with a spreadsheet style interface for frequentist and Bayesian analyses.

name: DORA
description: Initiative calling for responsible assessment of research based on content rather than journal metrics, with signatory lists and practical guidance for institutions.
publisher: DORA (San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment)

name: Information Commissioner's Office
description: United Kingdom regulator for data protection and information rights, publishing GDPR guidance, freedom of information advice, and enforcement notices.

name: Global Indigenous Data Alliance
description: Alliance advancing Indigenous data governance rights, author of the CARE principles for Indigenous data governance alongside the FAIR data principles.

name: Local Contexts
description: Organization providing Traditional Knowledge and Biocultural labels and notices that ground Indigenous protocols in digital collections, data, and research.

name: Data & Society Research Institute
description: Independent research institute studying the social and cultural issues arising from data centric technology, publishing public scholarship, briefs, and primers.

name: Ada Lovelace Institute
description: Independent research institute examining the ethical and societal impacts of artificial intelligence and data driven technology through evidence based reports.

name: AlgorithmWatch
description: Nonprofit research and advocacy organization analyzing how automated decision systems affect society, with reports on AI deployment in Europe.

name: Northwestern University Knight Lab
description: University team building open journalism tools such as TimelineJS, StoryMapJS, and SoundCite, free for publishers, museums, and educators.

name: Source
description: OpenNews publication featuring community written articles on data journalism, security, and the practice of software development in newsrooms.

name: Storybench
description: Digital publication from Northeastern University covering how newsrooms use data, tools, and visualization, with behind the scenes methodology interviews.

name: Dataharvest
description: Annual European conference for data and investigative journalists, organized by Arena for Journalism in Europe, with masterclasses and cross border collaboration.

name: Visual Capitalist
description: Media outlet publishing data driven infographics and charts explaining markets, geopolitics, and technology, with licensing options for publishers.

name: Vega
description: Declarative visualization grammar from the University of Washington Interactive Data Lab, with Vega-Lite providing a high level grammar for statistical graphics.
publisher: University of Washington Interactive Data Lab

name: Chart.js
description: Open source JavaScript charting library producing responsive canvas charts with simple configuration, widely embedded in dashboards and reports.

name: Browsertrix
description: Managed crawling platform from the Webrecorder project for high fidelity web archiving, with browser based crawling, collection quality control, and replay.

name: Library of Congress Web Archive
description: Library of Congress collections of archived websites, including United States election and news sites, open through public replay and catalog search.

name: Australian Government Web Archive
description: National Library of Australia archive of Australian government websites, preserving federal agency pages and publications for long term access.

name: Archivematica
description: Open source digital preservation system by Artefactual that processes collections into standardized archival packages using METS and PREMIS metadata.

name: Open Preservation Foundation
description: Foundation sustaining open source preservation tools such as jpylyzer and veraPDF, with community led development, training, and technology watch resources.

name: Digital Preservation Coalition
description: Global coalition of organizations advancing digital preservation, publishing the Digital Preservation Handbook, technology watch reports, and training resources.

name: Archives Unleashed
description: University of Waterloo project developing open source tools for turning web archives into research data, with text extraction and network analysis outputs.

name: National Weather Service API
description: United States National Weather Service API providing forecasts, alerts, station observations, and point metadata as open JSON endpoints without an API key.

name: Mobility Database
description: Open catalog and API of public transport feeds from MobilityData, standardizing discovery of GTFS and GTFS Realtime data across hundreds of providers.

name: OSRM
description: Open source routing engine for OpenStreetMap data with an HTTP API for routes, distance tables, and map matching, used for driving, foot, and bike routing.

name: STRING
description: Database of known and predicted protein-protein interactions integrating experimental and computational evidence across thousands of organisms, with a REST API.
access_requirements: Free for academic use; commercial use requires a license.

name: ChEMBL
description: Manually curated database of bioactive drug-like molecules with activities against biological targets, accessible through a web interface and REST web services.

name: openrouteservice
description: Routing and geospatial API built on OpenStreetMap data by Heidelberg University's GIScience group, offering directions, isochrones, matrix, and elevation services.
access_requirements: Free API key required after registration.

name: Art Institute of Chicago API
description: Open API exposing the Art Institute of Chicago's collections with images, metadata, and controlled vocabularies, released under a CC0 license.

name: Pinboard
description: Bookmarking service storing tagged pages with full text search of saved content, plus archival copies of bookmarked pages for a one-time fee.
access_requirements: One-time registration fee for an account.

name: Raindrop.io
description: Bookmark manager for saving, tagging, and grouping links across devices, with duplicate detection, broken link checks, and an API for integration.

name: Standard Ebooks
description: Volunteer project producing carefully formatted, open source editions of public domain literature with modern typography, proofreading, and polished metadata.

name: Project Gutenberg
description: Digital library of over 70,000 free public domain ebooks, mostly older literature digitized by volunteers, offered in EPUB, Kindle, and plain text formats.

name: Brave Search
description: Independent search engine built on its own web index, offering anonymous search without user profiles and a documented paid API for developers.

name: Miniflux
description: Minimalist, self-hosted RSS feed reader written in Go, with a clean web interface, feed filtering, and a documented REST API.

name: LibraryThing
description: Book cataloging community for cataloging personal libraries, with tagging, reviews, and metadata drawn from hundreds of library and commercial sources.

name: Common Attack Pattern Enumeration and Classification (CAPEC)
description: MITRE maintained encyclopedia of common attack patterns used by adversaries, mapped to CWE weaknesses and CVEs, with search and data downloads.

name: CIRCL
description: Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg, the national CERT for Luxembourg, publishing advisories, alerts, incident response guidance, and MISP training.

name: National Cyber Security Centre (Netherlands)
description: Dutch national cyber security centre publishing vulnerability advisories, threat assessments, and guidance for organizations, government, and the public.

name: National Cyber Security Centre Finland
description: Finnish national cyber security centre operated by Traficom, providing vulnerability coordination, security notices, and situational awareness reporting.

name: Australian Cyber Security Centre
description: Part of the Australian Signals Directorate, publishing advisories, alerts, incident reporting services, and practical guidance for Australian organizations.

name: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
description: Part of the Communications Security Establishment, publishing advisories, alerts, incident response services, and baseline security guidance for Canadians.

name: Cyber Security Agency of Singapore
description: National body coordinating cyber security for Singapore, publishing advisories and alerts, operating SingCERT, and running national cyber programmes.

name: FortiGuard Labs
description: Fortinet's global threat intelligence and research organization, publishing vulnerability advisories, threat alerts, and outbreak data for its products and the wider ecosystem.
